SD10-010.name: The StormDragon Supercell-Dragoon
SD10-010.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy two opposing 4000 BP or less Spirits.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
For each Spirit with [Charge] you control, this Spirit gains +2000 BP.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit.

SD10-016.name: Charge Draw
SD10-016.effect:
[Main]
Draw two cards. Then, reveal two cards from your decktop, and add every Spirit card/Brave card with [Charge] among them to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to your decktop in any order.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +3000 BP.

SD10-008.name: Dragon-Annura
SD10-008.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
All your Spirits with [Charge] gain +2000 BP.

[LV2] [Charge]
Increase the limit of your "BP Destruction effects" by +1000.

SD10-015.name: Fire Wall
SD10-015.effect:
[Flash]
By destroying a Red Spirit you control, when this battle ends, end the Attack Step. This effect can only be used during (Opposing Attack Step).

SD10-009.name: Sunpillar-Dragon

SD10-013.effect:

When your Life is reduced by the attacks of opposing Spirits, destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit that attacked.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
